## FLOOWBOX - LLM Output Quality Evaluator
3 specialized evaluator agents run in parallel:
- Agent A: Accuracy + factual correctness
- Agent B: Completeness + relevance
- Agent C: Safety + bias

Scores aggregated into a final verdict (PASS/PARTIAL/FAIL).
All evaluations logged to Google Sheets for trend tracking.

This implements LLM-as-Judge evaluation — a core pattern in AI safety research.
